gates.balance_chain: Report 2 (pages 4-6) CLOSES exactly: 0 + 500.36 - 500.36 = 0 = cover line 4 (0 in all three columns). Report 1 (pages 1-3) does NOT close: 8495 (balance last) + 2,250 (contrib this) - 273.99 (expense this) = 10,471.01, and the cumulative route 13,350 - 3,378.40 = 9,971.60, against a stated ending balance of 10,598.81 (written 10,598 superscript-81 in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells). Both figures retained verbatim; the residual is the FILER's arithmetic and was not adjusted. CROSS-FILING CHAIN (the swapped-cover test, run because this PDF holds two filings by one filer in one cycle): report 2's cumulative column (500.36 / 500.36 / 0) does NOT chain into report 1's 'TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT' column (11,100 / 3104.41 / 8495). That is EXPECTED and is not evidence of a swapped pair -- the two stapled reports are non-adjacent (Jun 17 2022 and Jan 5 2023) and at least one intervening 2022 report is simply not in this PDF; the covers are internally consistent with their own schedules and each names its own period.
